channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] OneBlood secures rare blood donations needed to save Florida teen's life
item.description: Gigi Felix is battling sickle cell disease, an inherited blood disorder. Doctors needed to secure 50 units of rare blood before moving forward with a life-saving bone marrow transplant.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] State halts new admissions at Peace River Center crisis unit after patient's death
item.description: One of Polk County's busiest mental health crisis facilities has been ordered to stop admitting new patients after a state investigation found serious failures in patient care following the death of a patient.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Energy Department pulled grant money from states that didn't vote for Trump, new filing says
item.description: Lawyers for the Trump administration say that decisions to end nearly 300 renewable energy grants were made based "solely" on whether recipients supported President Donald Trump in the 2024 election.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: city council] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Meet the candidates: Questionnaire for Oldsmar City Council Seat 3
item.description: Leading up to the 2026 Florida primary (August 19) and general election (November 3), Tampa Bay 28 contacted qualified candidates in Tampa Bay area races.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: county commission] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Meet the candidates: Questionnaire for Manatee County Commission D-6 At-Large
item.description: Leading up to the 2026 Florida primary (August 19) and general election (November 3), Tampa Bay 28 contacted qualified candidates in Tampa Bay area races.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] St. Pete sanitation worker killed: Charges filed against suspect after I-75 standoff
item.description: A 43-year-old man will face first-degree murder and felony gun charges after allegedly killing a St. Petersburg sanitation worker inside her truck Wednesday before leading law enforcement on an I-75 chase in Lee County.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] West Hernando Branch Library: County proposes permanent closure amid expected budget cuts
item.description: County leaders in Hernando County are considering the permanent closure of a public library that has served local residents for four decades as part of proposed budget reductions.
